user.title: Sign in to Xiaomi Home
user.description: Use Xiaomi Home QR to approve access from your phone. For password sign-in, enter the account details below.

data.region: Xiaomi Home region (de for most European accounts)

qr.title: Approve access in Xiaomi Home
qr.description:
Scan this code in Xiaomi Home and approve access. Then select **Submit** in Home Assistant.

![Xiaomi Home sign-in QR code]({qr_image})

[Open the QR image in a new tab]({qr_image}) · [Open the Xiaomi approval page]({qr_page})

verify.title: Verify your Xiaomi account
verify.description: Enter the code Xiaomi sent to your account.

captcha.title: Verify your Xiaomi account
captcha.description:
Solve the image code below to let Xiaomi send your verification code.

![CAPTCHA]({captcha_image})

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Xiaomi Home again
reauth_confirm.description: Approve access to the same Xiaomi account.

error.cannot_sign_in: Could not sign in. Check the account details and region.
error.credentials_required: Enter the Xiaomi account and password when using password sign-in.
error.qr_pending: Xiaomi has not confirmed approval yet. Confirm in Xiaomi Home, then submit again.
error.captcha_required: Xiaomi requested a CAPTCHA. Enter the characters shown in the image.
error.verification_required: Xiaomi requested an account verification method the setup wizard cannot complete.
error.verification_failed: The verification code was rejected or expired.

abort.no_cameras: There are no cameras in this Xiaomi account and region.
abort.qr_expired: The code expired. Start sign-in again to generate a new code.
abort.already_configured: This Xiaomi account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: A different Xiaomi account was used. Sign in to the original account.

init.title: Cameras in Home Assistant
init.description: Choose the cameras to use in Home Assistant. Enabling the experimental C201 or C701 microphone adds audio to live playback and recordings. C701 also enables its push-to-talk control.

data.c400_low_resolution: C400 cameras to stream at lower resolution
